FYI: “Unable to match” is not the same as “this bullet was not fired by this gun.” It’s likely just an analyst being careful.

I haven’t yet seen the report by the firearms examiner, but I’d caution against making too much of this. There is no scientific basis for “matching” one bullet to one gun.
